description:
Sleep Without Waking | Slow Bamboo Flute | 3 Hours of Hold one unbroken texture through the whole night so nothing wakes you

It is not falling asleep that is the problem. It is 3am, and being awake again, and the hours until morning.

This peaceful Indian ambient meditation music is designed to hold one unbroken texture through the whole night so nothing wakes you.

Enjoy 3 hours of low breathy bamboo flute over a soft tanpura drone, with no dynamic jumps and no silences, looped seamlessly so nothing interrupts you.

Perfect for sleeping through the night, waking at 3am, insomnia, light sleepers, shift work, jet lag, noisy neighbours, restless nights, napping, keeping a room from going silent.

🎵 ABOUT THIS MUSIC
Instrument: Bansuri
Raga: Bageshri
Style: Indian classical ambient, instrumental only
Mood: Calm, steady, unhurried
Duration: 3 hours

🎧 HOW TO USE
Keep the volume low enough that it sits underneath the room rather than filling it. Headphones deepen the drone, but this works just as well through a speaker.

⏱ CHAPTERS
0:00:00 — Settling in
0:15:00 — The room going quiet
0:30:00 — First depth
0:45:00 — Steady through the hour
1:00:00 — Deeper
1:15:00 — Middle of the night
1:30:00 — Unbroken
1:45:00 — Still going
2:00:00 — Toward morning
2:15:00 — Last hour
2:30:00 — Light returning
2:45:00 — Fading out

⏱ BEST FOR
Sleeping through the night
Waking at 3am
Insomnia
Light sleepers
Shift work
Jet lag
Masking noise
Restless nights
Long naps
Keeping a room from going silent

If this music helped, subscribe to Raga Focus for more uninterrupted Indian ambient healing music.
